question.problem:
A volleyball school for children splits the players into three teams, team $1,$ team $2,$ and team $3.$

- $54%$ of the children are in team $1,$ and $20%$ of players in this team have been playing volleyball for over a year.

- $32%$ of the children are in team $2,$ and $30%$ of players in this team have been playing volleyball for over a year.

- $14%$ of the children are in team $3,$ and $15%$ of players in this team have been playing volleyball for over a year.

If $10%$ of the children can play in all positions, and $94%$ of children that can play in all positions have been playing for over a year, what is the probability that a randomly chosen child who has been playing for over a year can play in all positions? Round your answer to $3$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
Let $B$ be the event that a child can play in all positions, $I$ be the event that a child has been playing for over a year, and ${T}_{1},{T}_{2},{T}_{3}$ be the events that a child is in team $1,$ $2,$ or $3,$ respectively. 

Let's break down the information given in the problem statement:

- From the bullet points, we have the following information:

$$
\begin{aligned} & P({T}_{1})=0.54 &  & P(I|{T}_{1})=0.2 \\  & P({T}_{2})=0.32 &  & P(I|{T}_{2})=0.3 \\  & P({T}_{3})=0.14 &  & P(I|{T}_{3})=0.15\end{aligned}
$$

The disjoint union ${T}_{1}⊔{T}_{2}⊔{T}_{3}$ covers the entire sample space, and we have

$$
P({T}_{1})+P({T}_{2})+P({T}_{3})=0.54+0.32+0.15=1.
$$

- Since $10%$ of children can play in all positions, we have

$$
P(B)=0.1.
$$

- Since $94%$ of children who play in all positions have been playing for over a year, we have

$$
P(I|B)=0.94.
$$

We want to find the probability that a randomly chosen child who has been playing for over a year can play in all positions, which is represented as $P(B|I).$ 

Using Bayes' theorem combined with the law of total probability, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(B|I) & =\frac{P(I|B)P(B)}{P(I)} \\  & =\frac{P(I|B)P(B)}{P(I|{T}_{1})P({T}_{1})+P(I|{T}_{2})P({T}_{2})+P(I|{T}_{3})P({T}_{3})} \\  & =\frac{(0.94)(0.1)}{(0.2)(0.54)+(0.3)(0.32)+(0.15)(0.14)} \\  & =\frac{0.094}{0.225} \\  & ≈0.418,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
